design_weaknesses.known: Checkpoint criterion is observation-weighted BCE; competition target is equal-weight12finding AUC.
design_weaknesses.implication: Synovitis contributes1.97% and Fracture3.11% of global observed cells versus12.98% MedialMeniscus; each class has8.33% of macroAUC. Correct missing-mask accumulation does not resolve surrogate mismatch.
design_weaknesses.hypothesis: Macro-balanced loss may improve neglected findings, but increasing noisy-label weight can also hurt.
design_weaknesses.action: Preserve loss for initial f005 contrast; record per-target BCE/AUC/support. Any macro-loss change is a new prespecified single-factor experiment.

proposed_adoption_rules_before_real_fit.technical_gate: All24shards complete and exactly4207/wholegroup/Gold exclusion/hash/array checks pass; CUDA/resource gate and strict suffix/head Report-free reload pass. Until then no real fit.
proposed_adoption_rules_before_real_fit.initial_research_promote: Compare BCE-selected frozen vs last2 in folds0/1. Advance only when weakBCE improves and auxiliary11 AUC increases in both folds, with supported-target regressions and paired-group uncertainty explicitly reviewed. No mandatory every-class increase and no Public claim.
proposed_adoption_rules_before_real_fit.inconclusive: Onefold-only gain, a single rare-class spike, both bootstrap intervals crossing0, or epoch12 boundary selection: preserve results and baseline; decide one prespecified confirmatory factor rather than an LR/dropout/epoch sweep.
proposed_adoption_rules_before_real_fit.reject_this_setting: Consistent worsening of both weakBCE and auxiliary11 or technical failure. Preserve the frozen reference; no promotion and no general claim that all fine-tuning fails.
proposed_adoption_rules_before_real_fit.confirmation: After fixing the proposedcandidate, extend CLI via a separate reviewed plan to fixedfold2; checkpoint selection remains weakBCE. Morefolds/seeds only for the shortlisted candidate and adequate time.
proposed_adoption_rules_before_real_fit.serving_and_Public: Only a candidate surviving research and Report-free source/resource gates gets a standalone/previouslyfixed small blend evaluation. Publicscore is recorded as its own outcome, not converted from weakAUC or a guaranteed target.
